parameters.raw_text: The per capita recovery rate is probably the most certain of all parameters in the model. It is approximately equal to the reciprocal of the duration of infection (1/γ), a parameter that more data are available.
parameters.description: The per capita recovery rate from cholera infection.
parameters.text_span: The per capita recovery rate is probably the most certain of all parameters in the model. It is approximately equal to the reciprocal of the duration of infection (1/γ), a parameter that more data are available.

parameters.raw_text: 1/δ Cholera life span in water reservoir (days) 3 to 41 Usually not measured; depending on local environment (temperature, salinity), nature of the water source (running or static), cholera phage concentration. Historical experimental data available.
parameters.description: The life span of cholera bacteria in the water reservoir.

parameters.raw_text: The basic reproduction number, R0, is usually defined as the number of individuals that an infected (and infectious) individual can infect when he or she is introduced into a completely susceptible population.
